title: 2025年北京市初中学业水平考试英语真题
subject: 英语
sourceOrganization: 北京高考在线（转载整理）

copyrightNote: 依据公开转载扫描版试卷及答案人工校验并结构化，非北京市教育考试院官方发布。
instructions: 本卷共38道小题，满分60分，考试时间90分钟。客观题自动评分，主观题显示参考答案。

sections.title: 一、单项填空（每题0.5分，共6分）

questions.prompt: My sister is good at singing. ______ can even sing some French songs.
questions.explanation: My sister 应由 She 指代。

questions.prompt: These Chinese astronauts will stay in the space station ______ six months.
questions.explanation: for + 时间段。

questions.prompt: —Mom, ______ I go to the cinema with my classmates this Sunday afternoon? —Yes, of course you can.
questions.explanation: can 用于请求许可。

questions.prompt: The National Library of China is ______ public library in Asia.
questions.explanation: 范围 in Asia 要求最高级，并加 the。

questions.prompt: —Steve, ______ did you begin to learn how to play chess? —About two years ago.
questions.explanation: 答语是时间。

questions.prompt: Janet has done a lot for us, ______ we want to write her a thank-you letter.
questions.explanation: 前因后果使用 so。

questions.prompt: Mary ______ a picture when her dad got home yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 过去某时正在发生，使用过去进行时。

questions.prompt: Charlie ______ his grandparents every weekend. He loves them very much.
questions.explanation: every weekend 表示一般现在时。

questions.prompt: —Did you play table tennis after school yesterday? —No. We ______ vegetables in our school garden.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示一般过去时。

questions.prompt: Many international students ______ to visit our school since last year.
questions.explanation: since last year 与现在完成时连用。

questions.prompt: Language learning apps ______ by more and more people these days.
questions.explanation: apps 与 use 构成一般现在时被动语态。

questions.prompt: —Linda, do you know ______ for the school trip this term? —We are going to the Capital Museum.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句使用陈述语序，且表示计划。

sections.title: 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分）
sections.instructions: 短文讲述 Sophia 与外公每年制作苹果蛋糕的家庭传统，以及这份传统唤回共同记忆的故事。

questions.passage: At eleven, Sophia discovered that her grandfather—who was rarely in the kitchen—was the master behind her favorite New Year apple cake. She began making it with him every year. As Grandpa grew older and forgot their tradition, Sophia guided him through it. Later, when he was in hospital, she made the cake herself and brought it to the family gathering. Grandpa saw it, smiled, and their shared memories seemed to return.
questions.prompt: Sophia was greatly ______ when she learned Grandpa made the cake.
questions.explanation: 她从未想到外公是蛋糕制作者，因此感到惊讶。

questions.prompt: She thought it was a chance to ______ with him.
questions.explanation: 一起做蛋糕是增进联系的机会。

questions.prompt: She took out the apples ______ as usual.
questions.explanation: 她像往年一样开心地准备做蛋糕。

questions.prompt: Making the apple cake was their family ______.
questions.explanation: 每年重复的家庭活动是 tradition。

questions.prompt: Sophia ______ Grandpa in making the cake.
questions.explanation: 外公忘记步骤后，Sophia 引导他制作。

questions.prompt: She made the cake to bring a bit of ______ to the family in hospital.
questions.explanation: 熟悉的蛋糕给住院期间的家人带来安慰。

questions.prompt: She was ______ herself because the cake lacked Grandpa’s touch.
questions.explanation: 她担心味道不好，因而怀疑自己。

questions.prompt: Everyone surrounded Grandpa, creating some ______.
questions.explanation: 家人围在一起营造温暖气氛。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解（每题2分，共26分）

questions.passage: A: modern city tour. B: forests and mountains. C: beach and sea activities. D: African wildlife and camping.
questions.prompt: Tina wants to see African animals and sleep in a tent in the wild. Which picture fits her plan?
questions.explanation: 非洲野生动物与露营对应 D。

questions.prompt: Kevin wants to hike, climb trees and go birdwatching in North America. Which picture fits?
questions.explanation: 森林和山地活动对应 B。

questions.prompt: Nancy plans to swim and play volleyball on an Australian beach. Which picture fits?
questions.explanation: 海滩活动对应 C。

questions.passage: A boy planted flower bulbs with his mother and watched the empty garden hopefully through winter. When the flowers bloomed, his mother suggested secretly leaving baskets for neighbors. He resisted at first, but after seeing a neighbor smile, he understood that beauty and kindness are meant to be shared.
questions.prompt: How did the writer feel while watching the garden during winter?
questions.explanation: 原文说他 watched hopefully。

questions.prompt: What happened to the baskets of flowers?
options: They were shown at an exhibition.
questions.explanation: 花篮被悄悄放到邻居门口。

questions.prompt: What made the writer’s heart full?
options: The honor of helping people in need.
The happiness of getting close to nature.
questions.explanation: 分享美与善意给他带来满足。

questions.passage: Researchers built a robotic arm and controller from plant- and animal-based materials. They were strong during use but broke down naturally in soil. Such biodegradable soft robots may one day handle dangerous waste or assist doctors, although their electronics and power systems must also become biodegradable.
questions.prompt: What is special about the robotic arm and controller?
questions.explanation: 它们能自然降解，较为环保。

questions.prompt: What is mentioned about soft robots in Paragraph 5?
questions.explanation: 该段介绍处理危险废物和辅助医疗等用途。

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the passage?
options: Soft robots already clean most e-waste.
They must rest after heavy use.
Their design borrows ideas from nature.
questions.explanation: 软体机器人从自然界获取设计灵感。

questions.passage: AI models mirror human rules, data and beliefs. Hiring and lending systems have reproduced existing unfairness rather than creating it from nothing. The writer argues that companies and ordinary people must examine the data and behavioral footprints that train AI, keeping their actions consistent with their principles.
questions.prompt: Why does the writer introduce two examples in Paragraph 2?
questions.explanation: 两个案例支持 AI 反映既有人类偏见的观点。

questions.prompt: What does “diverge” most probably mean?
questions.explanation: 语境指原则与行动彼此分离。

questions.prompt: What is a good example of shaping AI responsibly?
options: Being mindful of what we feed into AI models.
questions.explanation: 应关注输入 AI 的数据与行为痕迹。

questions.prompt: Which is the best title?
options: AI Isn’t the Problem; We Are
AI: A Tool to Reshape Our Society
More Open Algorithms for Better AI
questions.explanation: 文章核心是 AI 映照人类已有规则、偏见与行为。

questions.passage: Modern life often values speed and quantity, leaving people in a constant rush. The Slow Movement argues that the answer is not to live faster but to live more slowly. Beginning with Slow Food, it spread to work, travel and city life. Its central idea is to value quality over quantity and experience each moment wholeheartedly.
questions.prompt: Why do people choose fast living?
questions.answer: Because they think they have no control of time.
questions.explanation: 参考答案：Because they think they have no control of time.

questions.prompt: What is the answer to our predicament according to the Slow Movement?
questions.answer: To learn how to live slower.
questions.explanation: 参考答案：The answer is to learn how to live slower.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the Slow Movement?
questions.explanation: 参考答案：The main idea is to value quality over quantity.

questions.prompt: Which lifestyle do you prefer, fast living or slow living? Give two reasons.
questions.answer: Open answer with a clear preference and two relevant reasons.
questions.explanation: 示例：I prefer slow living because it reduces stress and helps me enjoy moments of rest. 言之有理即可。

questions.prompt: 任选一题，写不少于50词：①根据40名同学做家务的调查图（32人sometimes，6人usually，2人seldom），说明结果并提出劳动建议；②为学校“书香校园”活动设计你的 Dream Library，并说明学生能从中获得的益处。
questions.answer: 内容应覆盖所选题目的全部提示，语言准确，结构连贯，不少于50词。
questions.explanation: 题目①需概述调查数据并提出建议；题目②需描述理想图书馆并说明益处。
